where.zh: 空蕩島上的探索與建造（全島同一種曲風）
where.en: Exploring and building on the Empty Isle (one mood for the whole island)

where.zh: 附近有怪物（或哥布林王）來襲時，加上鼓聲與快速琴音
where.en: When monsters (or the awake Goblin King) are close: frame drum and fast zither runs

harness.notes: js/music.js is an ES module that imports ./sound.js; it only plays once sound.js's wake() has created the AudioContext (tick() returns while audio().ac is null). wake() is not re-exported by music.js, so init imports the SAME module URL (/brick-builders/js/sound.js, which is what ./sound.js resolves to) and calls wake(), then music.start() (setInterval 200 ms, 0.6 s look-ahead). init returns a Promise: the renderer must await it before play/render. If init is not awaited, put the same code in play.

notes: Generative music: Karplus-Strong guzheng random-walking a pentatonic scale (Math.random), so there is no fixed loop; loopSec null, renderSec 75. game.js never calls music.mood(), so the island always uses the 'open' mood; only the fight flag changes it. music.js and sound.js are byte-identical to WulinWorld's. sound.js ambience (wind/birds/rain noise) is not music and not started here.
